fusions.name: Staghorn Graze
fusions.desc: Scrapes the target with coral-crusted spurs for 8 damage and leaves it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds. Each use costs 4% of your maximum health, and its damage rises 6% for every tenth of your health already gone, up to 30%.

fusions.name: Reefbreak Thrash
fusions.desc: Thrashes in a ring, dealing 26 damage that ignores armour to every enemy within 3 tiles. Its damage rises 8% for each ally beside you, up to 32%.

fusions.name: Nesting Outcrop
fusions.desc: Grows a coral nest at your feet that stands for 15 seconds and strikes an enemy within 4 tiles for 5 damage every 1.5 seconds. The effect grows 8% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 4 allies.

fusions.name: Limestone Crust
fusions.desc: When you are healed, you gain a shield worth 12% of your maximum health for 5 seconds. Once every 15 seconds.
